svg.title: IBM i in three of IBM’s dates and terms
svg.desc: Three of IBM's dates and terms for IBM i: the Service Extension Offering for IBM i 7.4 runs to September 30, 2029; IBM i 7.5 and 7.6 have no date set, and IBM will give at least 12 months' notice; IBM's Enhanced policy gives a minimum of 5 years' support with an extension of 3 years. Each date and term is IBM's own, from its IBM i lifecycle pages.
